D01.label: accurate
D01.note_text: On Saturday, 7th November, Neil punched Gareth in the face during an argument in the kitchen about the sale of the house.

D02.label: accurate
D02.note_text: Gareth's nose was broken during the incident, and he was taken to hospital that night. Gareth was treated at Castlebrook General Hospital A and E, where an x-ray confirmed a broken nose.

D03.label: accurate
D03.note_text: After being punched, Gareth was on the floor and was hit in the back and shoulder with a kitchen chair.
D03.why: chair, hit, back kept; passive voice omits 'by Neil' but context makes the actor clear

notes: S17 weakens the knife denial to 'did not believe', still not a claim he had one. S12 'was taken to hospital' conflicts with s18 'drove himself'.
